characters.summary: Kingsley Shacklebolt is an elite Auror and high-ranking member of the Order of the Phoenix who excels in dueling multiple opponents simultaneously. He relies on advanced combat spells, protective enchantments, and rapid wandwork.
limitations: Requires verbal or somatic wand gestures for most high-level combat spells.

sources.supports: Duelling skills as an Auror, membership in the Order of the Phoenix, and magical capabilities.

feats.claim: Fought against multiple Death Eaters simultaneously during the Battle of the Department of Mysteries and the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Battle of the Department of Mysteries
notableResults.note: Fought alongside other Order members against Death Eater forces.

campaignTags.claim: Wields a wand to cast complex protective and offensive magic
Able to magically apparate to relocate during combat

unknowns: Exact limits of his non-verbal magic mastery compared to Albus Dumbledore.

characters.summary: Kreacher is a house-elf possessing potent innate magic independent of a wand, allowing him to bypass standard anti-apparition wards. He uses stealth, speed, and house-elf magic to overwhelm adversaries.
weaknesses: Bound by servitude to masters unless explicitly freed or commanded otherwise.
limitations: Psychologically and magically compelled to obey direct commands from rightful masters.

sources.supports: House-elf magic capabilities, wandless teleportation, and combat during the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Led the house-elves of Hogwarts into battle against the Death Eaters.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.note: Led house-elves in attacking Death Eaters.

campaignTags.claim: Able to teleport without a wand via house-elf apparition

unknowns: Full capacity of house-elf offensive magic when not restricted by master commands.

characters.summary: Lavender Brown is a student at Hogwarts and member of Dumbledore's Army who possesses standard scholastic magical training. She participates in defensive skirmishes but lacks elite combat experience.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical and magical attacks due to standard human durability and limited combat experience.
limitations: Limited repertory of advanced combat magic.

sources.supports: Membership in Dumbledore's Army and participation in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Practiced defensive spells and jinxes as a member of Dumbledore's Army.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.note: Attacked and severely injured by the werewolf.

campaignTags.claim: Casts standard wizarding spells using a wand

unknowns: Exact extent of injuries and recovery outcome in the book versus film continuities.

characters.summary: Lee Jordan is a Hogwarts student and member of Dumbledore's Army who utilizes standard wand combat and tactical coordination. He later runs underground radio resistance broadcasting.
limitations: Relies on standard wizarding capabilities without exceptional combat prowess.

sources.supports: Dumbledore's Army membership and participation in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Fought alongside resistance members during the Second Wizarding War.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.note: Participated in defending the castle alongside other Dumbledore's Army members.

campaignTags.claim: Able to cast spells with a wand

unknowns: Specific individual dueling victories during the final battle.

characters.summary: Leta Lestrange is a powerful witch from an ancient magical family, proficient in dark arts, protective magic, and dynamic wand combat.

sources.supports: Magical abilities, family background, and confrontation with Gellert Grindelwald.

feats.claim: Struggled against and distracted Gellert Grindelwald's gathered followers at Père Lachaise Cemetery.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
notableResults.note: Sacrificed herself after being consumed by Grindelwald's blue fire curse.

campaignTags.claim: Casts advanced magic using a wand

unknowns: Full extent of her magical training outside of Hogwarts and Ministry work.

characters.summary: Lily Potter was a highly accomplished witch known for her proficiency in charms and potions. Her defining magical feat is the creation of a powerful sacrificial blood protection charm.
weaknesses: Standard human vulnerability to direct attacks when unprotected.
limitations: Physical combat abilities were limited compared to frontline Aurors.

sources.supports: Academic prowess, membership in the Order of the Phoenix, and sacrificial magic.

feats.claim: Generated an ancient, impenetrable love-protection barrier through her self-sacrifice that repelled Lord Voldemort's killing curse.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

notableResults.note: Her sacrifice caused Voldemort's killing curse to rebound upon himself.

campaignTags.claim: Wields a wand and casts protective charms

unknowns: Extent of her active combat engagements during the First Wizarding War.

characters.summary: Lord Voldemort is the most feared and powerful dark wizard of his era, specializing in lethal dark magic, non-verbal spellcasting, flight without support, and horcrux-based immortality.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to sacrificial protection and substances that destroy horcruxes (such as basilisk venom)
limitations: Dependent on his wand's core compatibility or acquiring an external master wand for maximum efficacy.

sources.supports: Mastery of dark arts, unassisted flight, Horcruxes, and dueling capabilities.

feats.claim: Fought Albus Dumbledore to a stalemate at the Ministry of Magic.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

feats.claim: Killed numerous powerful witches and wizards over multiple decades.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Intense duel in the Atrium resulting in a standoff.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Final defeat when his killing curse rebounded due to wand ownership mechanics.

campaignTags.claim: Master of advanced dark magic and wand-based spells
Capable of independent human flight without broom or support
Able to apparate and disappear across vast distances

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how he created his physical rebirth potion in Goblet of Fire.

characters.summary: Empowered by the Elder Wand, Lord Voldemort possesses enhanced magical potency, magnified destructive spell output, and supreme confidence in dueling.
weaknesses: The Elder Wand refuses to truly harm its rightful master, creating a fatal vulnerability against Harry Potter.
limitations: Subject to the unique allegiance laws of the Elder Wand.
characters.formDifferences: Wields the Elder Wand, increasing his raw spell output and destructive capability, though allegiance limitations create a fatal flaw against the true master of the wand.

sources.supports: Properties of the Elder Wand and its allegiance rules.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated because the Elder Wand refused to kill its true master, causing the curse to rebound.

unknowns: Whether the Elder Wand granted any unique powers beyond amplified spellcasting.

characters.summary: Lucius Malfoy is a wealthy and influential Death Eater skilled in dark artifacts, dueling curses, and political manipulation.
weaknesses: Cowardice under pressure and overconfidence in status.
limitations: Relies heavily on artifacts and allies rather than elite standalone dueling skill.

sources.supports: Death Eater status, usage of a wand concealed in a cane, and participation in major battles.

feats.claim: Led a group of Death Eaters into the Department of Mysteries to retrieve the prophecy.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Battle of the Department of Mysteries
notableResults.note: Arrested and imprisoned in Azkaban after the skirmish.

unknowns: Full capability of specific dark artifacts stored in his manor.

characters.summary: Luna Lovegood is a perceptive witch and member of Dumbledore's Army who employs unconventional charms, creature knowledge, and steady composure in dangerous situations.

mechanisms: Corporeal Patronus defense against dark entities

sources.supports: Membership in Dumbledore's Army, magical achievements, and combat participation.

feats.claim: Fought through the Battle of the Department of Mysteries, Astronomy Tower, and Battle of Hogwarts without major injury.

notableResults.citation: Battle of the Department of Mysteries
notableResults.note: Successfully defended herself and allies alongside Dumbledore's Army.
